testo:
■ Choose one of your creatures. You may draw a card for each card that creature consists of. Then for each card the creature consists of, choose one of your opponent's creatures and return it to its owner's hand.
■ This turn, your opponent can't cast spells that cost the same as or less than the number of cards in your hand.
